map.：v_x = 20×cos30 = 17.32 m/s，v_y = 20×sin: vx = 20 x cos30 = 17.32 m/s and vy = 20 x sin30 = 10 m/s. Horizontal motion is uniform and vertical feels gravity.

map.分量为什么分开算？: Why Are the Components Computed Separately?
map.水平不受力匀速、竖直受重力匀变，拆开后各自独立再用运动学公式，是弹道标准做法。: Horizontally there is no force so motion is uniform; vertically gravity gives uniform acceleration. Splitting them makes each independent and then applying the kinematics formulas is the standard ballistic approach.
map.为什么水平分量一直不变、竖直分量却在变？: Why Does the Horizontal Component Stay Constant While the Vertical One Changes?
map.忽略空气阻力时水平方向没有受力（加速度为 0），所以 vₓ 恒定；竖直方向始终受: Ignoring air resistance there is no horizontal force (acceleration 0), so vx is constant; the vertical direction always feels gravity, so vy drops about 9.8 m/s each second, reaches 0 at the apex and then grows negative.
